evaluation_criteria.notes: Three mandatory qualification gates for HR advisory services. Proponents must confirm compliance with each requirement via Yes/No response.

evaluation_criteria.title: Minimum Qualification Gates

evaluation_criteria.notes: Mandatory gate requiring confirmation of strategic HR advisory experience in talent management, organizational development, workforce planning, succession planning, change management, or performance management.

source_refs.excerpt: Strategic HR Consulting Experience - Proponents must confirm that they have experience delivering at least three (3) strategic HR advisory engagements within the last three (3) years in at least two of the following areas: talent management, organizational development, workforce planning, succession planning, change management, performance management
source_refs.source_doc: OriginalRevision/RFP 2026-026 - Appendix C2 - Minimum qualification requirements.xlsx

evaluation_criteria.threshold: At least three (3) engagements within last three (3) years in at least two specified areas
evaluation_criteria.title: Strategic HR Consulting Experience

evaluation_criteria.notes: Mandatory gate requiring confirmation of staffing capacity with qualified senior consultants.

source_refs.excerpt: Senior Advisory Resources - Proponents must confirm they have a minimum of at least three (3) senior HR consultants with a minimum of seven (7) years of experience providing strategic HR advisory services.
source_refs.source_doc: OriginalRevision/RFP 2026-026 - Appendix C2 - Minimum qualification requirements.xlsx

evaluation_criteria.threshold: Minimum three (3) senior HR consultants with minimum seven (7) years experience
evaluation_criteria.title: Senior Advisory Resources

evaluation_criteria.notes: Mandatory gate requiring confirmation of experience delivering services to large organizations.

source_refs.excerpt: Experience with Large/Complex Organizations - Proponents must confirm they have delivered at least two (2) HR advisory engagements for organizations with more than 1,000 employees.
